findings.statement: EVP_DigestUpdate (src/evp/digest.rs:2559) calls dupdate((*ctx).algctx, ...) with no NULL test. A refused NEWCTX (:2328-2332) leaves digest set and algctx NULL; EVP_DigestUpdate with count>0 (the count==0 early return is :2496) then reaches an update body that dereferences ctx. Six audited rows are affected: digest.rs:700 (SHA1), :1207 (MD5-SHA1), :1371 (SHA3), :2000 (BLAKE2) and legacyprov.rs:378 (MD4/WP/RIPEMD), :582 (MDC2). Control B3-UPDATE-NULL; repair canary K3.

EVP_DigestSqueeze (src/evp/digest.rs:2891) calls dsqueeze((*ctx).algctx, ...) with no NULL test. shake_squeeze (src/provider/digest.rs:1403) has no NULL arm and, for outlen>0, ossl_sha3_squeeze dereferences (*ctx).xof_state (src/digest/sha3.rs:443). Affected row: OSSH-V1I-021. Control B3-SQUEEZE-NULL; repair canary K4.

The legacy provider finals (src/provider/legacyprov.rs:360 internal_final, :564 mdc2::internal_final) dereference a NULL algctx reached through EVP_DigestFinal_ex:2646 / FinalXOF:2779. Their dispatch tables publish no GETTABLE_CTX_PARAMS (legacyprov.rs:392-433, 592-641), so EVP_MD_CTX_get_size_ex falls back to the static size and does not stop the call. Affected rows: OSSH-V1I-084, 090. Control B3-FINAL-NULL; repair canary K5.

The legacy provider copyctx rows (src/provider/legacyprov.rs:336 macro, :544 mdc2) receive NULL outctx/inctx from EVP_MD_CTX_copy_ex:3042/3079; ptr::copy of size_of::<T>() through NULL is UB. The self-copy arm and the same-digest arm both pass (*out).algctx/(*in_).algctx untested. Affected rows: OSSH-V1I-082, 088. Control B3-COPY-NULL; repair canary K6.

summary.reject_root_cause: All 11 rejects are one family: the unguarded NULL-algctx sink in evp/digest.rs (dupdate:2559, dsqueeze:2891, dfinal:2646/2779, copyctx:3042/3079).
